QuestionStmt.S: Identify the major product obtained when anisole reacts with bromine in acetic acid.

Solution.S: Anisole (methoxybenzene) has an activating group (—OCH₃) which is ortho/para directing. On bromination with Br₂ in acetic acid, the major product is p-bromoanisole (para product) due to steric hindrance at ortho positions. Hence the correct option is C: p-bromoanisole.
